title: Fasmora 3.690.944 is available
message: A newer version of Fasmora is available with improved browsing, downloads, tabs, AI, popups, and update reliability.
whatsNew: Improved popup and sign-in session handling for more reliable website authentication
Improved downloads with safer resume handling and better authenticated download support
Improved long-press link actions, including opening links in a background tab
Improved Fasmora AI link handling and conversation behavior
Improved tab navigation, session ownership, and stale popup recovery
Improved update security with stronger APK validation and trusted download redirects
Improved browser stability and reliability across navigation and downloads
